jobs.description:
Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Hospitality Career?
Do you have experience in housekeeping and a passion for leading people? Are you looking for a workplace where your leadership skills are valued, your development is supported, and your efforts truly make a difference?
At OMNILS GROUP AB, we're not just cleaning hotel rooms, we're creating exceptional guest experiences. We are now looking for an energetic and motivated Housekeeping Team Leader to join our growing team in Stockholm Arlanda.
If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy inspiring others, and want to be part of a company with ambitious growth plans, we'd love to hear from you!
Why Join OMNILS GROUP?
OMNILS GROUP is one of Sweden's growing hospitality service providers, specializing in housekeeping and facility services for hotels and Real Estates
Approximately 200,000 hotel rooms are served annually
Around 200 employees across Sweden
ISO-certified in 14001& 9001
Collective agreement for secure employment conditions in Visita, Almega.
Pension and insurance according to collective agreements

 We believe our success comes from our people. That's why we invest in our employees' growth, well-being, and future.
Our Core Values
Commitment
Happiness
Respect

Your Opportunity
As a Housekeeping Team Leader, you will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while inspiring and developing your team.
This is more than a supervisory role. It's an opportunity to build leadership experience, influence daily operations, and contribute to the success of some of Sweden's leading hotels.
You will act as the bridge between hotel management, housekeeping staff, and OMNILS leadership while helping maintain exceptional quality and guest satisfaction.
What You'll Do:
Lead, coach, and inspire your housekeeping team
Plan daily operations and allocate responsibilities efficiently
Ensure exceptional cleaning quality and service standards
Conduct quality inspections and provide feedback
Support employee development and training
Collaborate closely with hotel management and reception teams
Monitor schedules, attendance, and reporting
Manage housekeeping supplies and inventory
Step into operations when needed and lead by example
Create a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment

Who You Are:
We're looking for someone who is positive, reliable, flexible and motivated by helping others succeed.
Requirements:
At least 1-2 years of housekeeping experience within hotels
Previous experience leading or supervising a team
Strong communication and people skills
Excellent organization and problem-solving abilities
Detail-oriented with a passion for quality
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
Proficient in Swedish and/or English
Driving license is an advantage
Valid work permit in Sweden or Swedish citizenship

 
What We Offer
Career Growth
We believe in promoting from within. High-performing Team Leaders can develop into Supervisors, Operations Coordinators, Quality Controllers, and other leadership positions as the company grows.
Training & Development
Leadership training
Quality management training
Ongoing coaching and support

Apply Today
We review applications on an ongoing basis, which means the position may be filled before the application deadline 2026/12/21

The opportunity
We are looking for Software Engineers to join our global HVDC Control & Protection Software team within System Supervision & Communication. In this role, you will work together with experienced engineers and learn how software is developed, tested, and maintained for HVDC systems using the MACH™ platform. You will contribute to real HVDC projects while developing your skills in software engineering, testing, system integration, and industrial communication.
How You'll Make an Impact
Support software development, testing, and verification activities for HVDC projects.
Develop and maintain software with guidance from experienced engineers.
Perform software testing and help identify and solve technical issues.
Prepare and update technical documentation.
Work together with engineers from other Control & Protection teams, IT/OT, Hardware, and Operations.
Take responsibility for assigned tasks and ask for support when needed.
Learn Hitachi Energy engineering processes, tools, and ways of working.
Follow Hitachi Energy's values, with particular focus on safety, integrity, and teamwork.
As you gain experience, there may be opportunities to support commissioning activities and customer projects.

Your Background
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or soon to graduate, in Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Power Systems, or a related field.
Basic programming and software development knowledge.
Interest in software testing, automation, digital control systems, or industrial communication.
Basic knowledge of tools such as Git or Azure DevOps is an advantage, but not required.
Knowledge of HVDC, power systems, EtherCAT, or other industrial communication protocols is an advantage.
Willingness to learn and develop your technical skills.
Good teamwork and communication skills.
Professional working proficiency in English. Swedish or other languages are an advantage.

More About Us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual, fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well-being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
Health care and wellness allowance
Health insurance including dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 SEK/month via salary deduction)

jobs.occupation: Danish-speaking Customer Support Agent to a Leading Finance & Tech Company
jobs.description:
Join a rapidly growing leader in accounting, payroll, and tax services. Be part of a dynamic team driving efficiency and user satisfaction in a collaborative environment where exceptional service and personal connection are at the heart of everything we do.
About the role
On behalf of our client, we are seeking a service dedicated, Danish-speaking Customer Support Agent who thrives on direct client interaction. In this role, you will work with technical and functional support at a fast growing company within accounting, payroll, and tax. You will serve as a key point of contact for users of the company’s proprietary business system. The position involves handling incoming cases via phone and email, with a strong focus on phone interaction, troubleshooting, and guiding users through issues with warmth, patience, and clarity.
We are looking for someone who can start immediately. The assignment will initially last six months, with strong opportunities for both extension and permanent employment. You will be based at the modern office in central Stockholm,.
With the possibility to work from home two days per week.
You are offered
An assignment at a leading company within the accounting industry
A close-knit team with a welcoming and inclusive culture, as well as an engaged Group Manager
Opportunities for skills development in customer service case management with a focus on IT and finance
A dedicated Consultant Manager from Academic Work who will support and coach you in your continued career

Work tasks
As a Danish-speaking Customer Support Agent, you will support customers and internal users in Denmark through:
Handling incoming support cases via phone and email, prioritizing personal connection and high-quality service on every case  
Acting as the first point of contact for customer users and internal employees when troubleshooting technical issues in Aspia’s business system and its integrated subsystems  
Maintaining collaboration with Second Line support and other cross-functional teams  
Contributing to the development of processes and routines

We are looking for
Has fluent proficiency in Danish, both spoken and written
Has very good proficiency in English, both spoken and written
Has previous experience in customer support
Is comfortable, confident, and genuinely enjoys talking on the phone
Has good system and computer skills

It is meritorious if you have
Background in economics and/or interest in IT
Experience with accounting and/or business systems

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Service-oriented approach
Solution- and quality-focused mindset
Strong communication skills
Responsible and driven work ethic

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: We are looking for an Experienced Hardware Lead Engineer!
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about high-performance electronics, embedded systems, and cutting-edge engine technology? Join our client’s innovative engineering team where your expertise in hardware design will directly impact next-generation technology. Apply today, as we review applications on an ongoing basis!
About the role
Our client is a specialist and market leader in advanced electronic engine management systems, Vessel/Vehicle control systems and Power distribution modules. They develop the hardware and software that optimizes performance, reduces fuel consumption, and lowers emissions for everything from marine and automotive applications to industrial engines running on renewable fuels and next- generation hybrid/electric systems with a legacy of high-octane motorsport.
As a Hardware Engineer, you will play an important role creating next-generation Electronic Control Units (ECUs). You will join a collaborative, highly technical engineering team where your work has a direct impact. Your market will be truly global, supporting customers across the EU, US, India, and the UK from initial specification all the way to mass production.
Work tasks
In this role, you will own the hardware development lifecycle. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality products on time and within scope. Your main responsibilities will include:
Group Lead: Work with daily planning and cost estimations and follow up of deliverables.
HW System Engineering: Designing an efficient System/ ECU layout to reaach safety, Performance and cost demands. This includes understanding the ECU outside environment and Performance requirements.
Future Concept: Define Next generation HW module solutions.
End-to-End Hardware Design: Developing specifications, schematics, component configurations, and PCB designs for advanced ECUs.
Documentation & Strategy: Creating Bill of Materials (BOM) and documented design strategies, including hardware design descriptions and precise calculations.
Design Verification: Ensuring technical excellence through rigorous testing and verification phases.
Customer Collaboration: Acting as a technical bridge for clients worldwide. This includes understanding their needs, supporting them from prototyping to certification, and occasionally traveling to client sites to help implement the products firsthand.

We are looking for
A university degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a similar field
A few years of experience in Hardware Engineering – preferably within a company in the automotive industry
Previous experience as a group Lead – daily planning and follow up of deliverables
Solid knowledge of embedded systems hardware
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken

It is meritorious if you have experience in:
Power electronics development
Emotor control
Unmanned Vessels/Vehicles
Low level software: HardWare InterFace (HWIF) and eTPU coding
Establishing and maintaining customer relations

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

Are you a supportive leader with a passion for process improvement and team development? 
About the role
Over the last five years, Akind Finance has transitioned into a centralized function. Today, we support operations across Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, Germany, and from 2027, Switzerland. Our portfolio of brands includes Academic Work, Winona, Brights, and Crowd Collective. During this journey, we have modernized our systems and successfully consolidated our Credit Management, Customer Invoicing, and Supplier Invoices teams into one unified AP/AR team.
As our new Group AP/AR Manager, you will report to the Group Finance Director and lead a team of AP/AR specialists, administrators, and finance assistants from our office in Linköping. As our AP/AR function enters its next chapter, your most critical task will be to provide supportive leadership that cultivates a strong foundation of trust and psychological safety, while actively driving continuous process improvements and optimization across our financial workflows. You will also be a key member of the Finance Management Team, contributing to strategic alignment and cross-functional collaboration.
Work tasks
You will hold the overall responsibility for all financial flows related to client and supplier payments.
You will provide visible, accessible leadership through regular dialogue, coaching, constructive feedback, and cross-training.
You will drive process improvements by continuously streamlining, standardizing, harmonizing, and automating our AP/AR end-to-end processes.
You will continuously streamline, standardize, and automate the AP/AR processes.
You will ensure accurate client and supplier invoicing and payments according to agreed terms.
You will deliver responsive, professional support to internal stakeholders, customers, and consultants while improving handovers.
You will establish and track relevant KPIs, goals, and targets within the AP/AR processes.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are a confident, approachable, and low-ego leader. You create trust through presence, clarity, and consistent follow-through. You communicate openly, address challenges directly, and help people understand both what needs to change and why. Above all, you enjoy developing people and building a team that shares knowledge and supports one another. You also naturally align with our core values: Show Heart, Share Energy, and Beat Yesterday.  
Required experience & background:
You have proven people leadership experience, including direct responsibility for a team, coaching, performance follow-up, and competence development.
You have a sound operational understanding of financial flows and experience from AP, AR, Invoicing, Credit Management, or a related transaction-intensive function.
You have demonstrated the ability to improve ways of working while involving employees and protecting the quality of daily delivery.
You have strong communication skills and professional fluency in English and Swedish.

Meritorious experience:
A degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related discipline.
Background in a complex, multi-company, or international organization.
Practical experience with automation, digitalization, system implementation, or AI-supported process improvement.
Additional language skills, particularly Finnish, German, or French.

Practical Information In this recruitment process, Akind is working together with Winona. If you have any questions, please contact Researcher Liisa Ehrenborg Unenge ++liisa.unenge@winonagroup.com++ or Consultant Sandra Isojärvi ++sandra.isojarvi@winonagroup.com++. We look forward to receiving your application!

Want to take new light technology from the lab out into the world?
About us
LunaLEC is a Swedish deep tech company that has mastered printed light. Just like text on a newspaper, the light-emitting structure is printed, forming a thin, patterned, flexible device. The light-emitting electrochemical cell (LEC) technology is built on 30 years of research, during which the team behind LunaLEC became the first in the world to fully print a light source. The technology is protected by several patents.
We are now taking the LEC technology from the lab to large-scale roll-to-roll production. This is your opportunity to be part of it from the start and build something significant, as well as working with technology that is not yet on the market. It is a pivotal stage for the company, and you could get the chance to lead it.
About the role
As Process Engineer, you will be the one who takes our process from the lab to industry. You will transfer today's sheet-to-sheet manufacturing to roll-to-roll and build the network of partners who will handle production, from substrates and printing to lamination and quality control. You will work closely with a team with deep expertise in the materials and the technology, while contributing with your experience in production. The role is new, and you will have a strong say in how it takes shape.
Your responsibilities will include:
Leading and owning the scale-up of our production from sheet-to-sheet to roll-to-roll
Implementing and optimising our processes in production environments with partners and in existing facilities
Leading the collaboration with our production partners and taking part in customer and partner demos as well as EU projects
Being responsible for quality, routines and compliance in production
Travelling internationally to implement and follow up production on site

We believe that you…
…hold a Master of Science in Engineering, for example in materials engineering, chemical engineering or physics. You have experience of production, roll-to-roll and process development. Experience of scaling a production process, solution based device fabrication at scale and printed electronics are merits. You communicate fluently in English.
As a person, you are driven, solution-oriented and enjoy taking responsibility. You take ownership of your areas and have a business-oriented mindset. Above all, you want to help build something new and see a unique technology reach the market.
We offer
🚀 The opportunity to become a valued part of a deep tech company on its way out into the world
💡 Plenty of room to make an impact and build a completely new function from the ground up
🌍 An international and dedicated team
✈️ International assignments and close collaboration with customers and partners
About the position
Employment type: Permanent (with an initial 6-month probationary period)
Start: By agreement
Scope: Full-time
Location: Umeå preferred, but remote work with regular visits to Umeå is possible. International travel is part of the role

Read more about us at www.lunalec.com

jobs.occupation: Industrial Painter / Surface Treatment Technician - Offshore - Norway
jobs.description:
Job description: 
Industrial painting, surface preparation and protective coating work on offshore oil and gas installations in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea. Typical work includes abrasive blasting, water jetting, coating application by airless spray / brush / roller, stripe coating, and application or repair of epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), including Chartek systems. Work is performed in accordance with project specifications, coating procedures, HSE requirements and client quality standards.

Requirements: 
- Minimum 2 years of relevant, documented experience in industrial painting and surface treatment.
- Hands-on experience with surface preparation, including abrasive blasting and/or high-pressure water jetting, and application of protective coating systems.
- Documented experience with epoxy intumescent passive fire protection (PFP), preferably Chartek or equivalent systems.
- Experience with NORSOK M-501 or equivalent offshore coating requirements is an advantage.
- Trade certificate (fagbrev) in industrial painting/surface treatment is an advantage. Candidates without a trade certificate must meet §13 or equivalent site-test competence requirements, where applicable.
- Minimum B1 level in a Scandinavian language: Norwegian, Swedish or Danish.
- Before offshore mobilisation, candidates must meet the assignment-specific requirements for recognised basic safety/emergency training and a valid offshore medical certificate. Exact certificate requirements will be confirmed during recruitment.
- Strong HSE awareness, quality focus, reliability and ability to work effectively in multicultural project teams.

Type of work contract: 
Permanent employment with JJS ProsjektPartner AS, subject to the applicable probationary period. Offshore assignments are normally organised on a 2 weeks on / 4 weeks off rotation, subject to client and project requirements.

Starting date: 
Expected start: 01.01.2027. Exact mobilisation date to be agreed with the selected candidate.

Working hours: 
Typical 2/4 offshore rotation: 14 days on / 28 days off, normally 12-hour shifts (168 working hours per 6-week rotation cycle), subject to the assignment schedule.

Place of work: 
Offshore installations in the Norwegian sector of the Norwegian Continental Shelf (NCS), depending on assignment.

Salary: 
Salary and applicable supplements in accordance with the relevant Norwegian collective agreement (tariff) and assignment-specific terms.

Other information: 
ProsjektPartner coordinates assignment-related travel and accommodation. Selected candidates will receive guidance on mobilisation, required documentation and client-specific courses. ProsjektPartner can assist with selected training through companies in NSE Gruppen.

About the company: 
JJS ProsjektPartner AS is a Norwegian staffing company specialising in qualified personnel for complex industrial projects, both onshore and offshore. With roots dating back to 2003 and as part of NSE Gruppen, we provide experienced professionals within industrial painting and surface treatment, insulation and cladding, scaffolding, and mechanical trades. Our focus is to supply the right competence at the right time, with high standards for HSE, quality and reliable project execution.

How to apply? 
Send your CV and relevant trade/certificate documentation to marco@propartner.no. Please include a short summary of your surface-treatment, offshore and PFP/Chartek experience. You may also call +47 975 92 360.

Contact: 
Marco Scharin
+47 975 92 360
marco@propartner.no

Marco speaks both Finnish, Norwegian and English, and Finnish-speaking candidates are welcome to contact him directly in Finnish.

At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for a driven Customer Success Specialist to support our Benelux operations.
About the Role
In this hybrid role, you will bridge relationship management with active credit risk assessment. You will manage incoming SMB loan applications, conduct financial health checks, and guide Dutch-speaking business owners through their lending journey, ensuring both strong customer satisfaction and healthy portfolio quality.
Key Responsibilities
Evaluate and process standard-to-mid complexity SMB loan applications using our risk frameworks and credit data.

Act as the main consultative contact for business applicants in Dutch, guiding them through underwriting and closing deals.

Analyze financial statements, cash flow patterns, and credit reports to verify deal quality and risk profiles.

Collaborate with senior underwriters on complex, high-ticket cases that require customized financing structures.

Act as a voice of the customer, sharing insights to continuously improve our product and localized operational processes.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a commercially driven, analytical team player who understands business finance and loves solving problems for entrepreneurs. You possess strong interpersonal skills, carry an eye for numerical detail, and are eager to take clear ownership of SMB credit applications.
Qualifications
A few years experience in Customer Success, B2B account management, strategic lending, or credit processing within Banking, Fintech, or Financial Services.

Hands-on familiarity with evaluating financial statements, corporate documents, and credit scoring models.

Native or professional fluency in Dutch, combined with strong professional English.

A structured approach, good business acumen, and a keen interest in SMB financing models.

Strong communication and negotiation skills with a drive to help small businesses succeed.

Detail-oriented, comfortable working with data, and skilled at prioritizing tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Why Qred?
This role offers a clear path to fast-track your career in commercial lending and fintech. Qred operates with a non-bureaucratic structure, short decision paths, and a high-performing culture where initiative is rewarded. You will take true ownership of your portfolio while deepening your credit and financial expertise alongside top industry talent.
One Last Thing
This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work together, which is why we have an office-first approach with the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis, and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

Job Scope
High level purpose of function.
Supports the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company's health and safety management system.
Ensures compliance with applicable work environment legislation, regulations, and company requirements. Identifies, assesses, and supports the control of occupational risks through risk assessments, exposure monitoring, inspections, and incident investigations.
Supports managers and operational teams in the daily work environment and safety activities, including risk assessments, investigations, and follow-up of incidents, near misses, and risk observations.
Promotes a proactive safety culture and contributes to continuous improvement of health and safety performance.
Key Responsibilities

Collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders across the organization to lead, coordinate, and advance systematic health and safety management and the development of a strong safety culture.
Participates in the work of building up a Health & Safety management system in accordance with the requirements of ISO 45001 and Lyten's internal standards.
Carry out training in health and safety.
Compile and follow up KPI´s and report to management and other relevant parties.
Support the organization in connection with risk assessments and other risk reviews.
If necessary, support with investigations of incidents and accidents, with the aim of finding root causes and proposing measures to prevent it from happening again.
Carry out investigations regarding physical work environment aspects such as exposure to chemical substances, noise, and ergonomic factors.
Support the organization with expertise within health and safety.
Inform, train, and coach leaders and employees in health and safety. 
Monitor and interpret changes in regulations.
Manage or perform occupational exposure measurement.
Manage and be superuser for existing systems regarding health and safety (TIA).
Provide technical solutions for change management and new projects within health and safety.
Lead or participate in health and safety related committees.
Contacts with authorities.

Accountability/Authorization

Budget responsibility: No
Direct reports: No
Manager work environment responsibility: No
All employees are accountable for complying with safety regulations and actively supporting a safe workplace.

Requirements
Educational background and previous experience required for the role.
Degree in engineering, occupational health and safety, work environment engineering, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent qualifications demonstrated through education and professional experience.
5+ years of work experience as a health and safety engineer, specialist or coordinator. 
Strong knowledge and experience with Swedish health and safety legislation, rules, regulations, and reporting processes. 
Good knowledge of data analysis and risk assessment methods.
Knowledge of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
Experience in the battery manufacturing industry is a plus. 
Expertise in specific areas within health and safety, for example ergonomics, ATEX, or chemicals is a plus.

Specific skills
Excellent English written and oral skills, Swedish is a plus.
Highly organized and result driven.
Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as independently.
Has a can-do attitude and an entrepreneurial spirit.
Qualities that we cherish are flexibility, sense of quality, friendliness, motivation to take on new challenges

About us
Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
We are now looking for a Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for developing Hacksaw Studios’ own games, bringing together expertise from different functions.
The Role
In this role, you will plan, coordinate, and support game projects from concept through to release. You will act as a central point of coordination between departments, helping teams stay aligned and ensuring that projects meet their timelines, quality standards, and creative goals.
Your key responsibilities include:
Taking ownership of assigned game projects, from initial planning through execution and delivery.
Creating and maintaining project plans, schedules, milestones, and priorities in our project management system.
Coordinating across functions to ensure an efficient workflow and alignment on project scope, goals, responsibilities, and deadlines.
Monitoring progress, quality, risks, and potential blockers, and supporting the teams in resolving issues proactively.
Facilitating project kick-offs, milestone check-ins, reviews, and other relevant meetings.
Keeping the Team Lead and relevant stakeholders informed about project progress, changes, risks, and key decisions.
Participating in review and feedback cycles to ensure consistency and high-quality deliverables.
Identifying improvements to workflows and tools that strengthen quality, efficiency, and collaboration.
Staying up to date with industry trends, game development practices, and player preferences.

What We’re Looking For
Experience in project management or production, ideally involving several projects or workstreams simultaneously.
A structured, organized, and proactive approach to your work.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and create clarity around responsibilities, priorities, and deadlines.
A collaborative mindset and the confidence to take ownership of assigned project areas.
The ability to identify risks and proactively seek guidance or clarification when needed.
Openness to feedback and a willingness to continuously develop your ways of working.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Nice to Have
Experience in the gaming or iGaming industry.
Experience coordinating creative and technical teams.
Familiarity with game development processes and project management tools.
Experience in or a strong interest in technology. 
A personal interest in games and game development.

What We Offer
A modern office in central Stockholm.
The opportunity to work with experienced and passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
The chance to help create games played by a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Wellbeing benefits, including a wellness allowance and regular in-office massages.

Practical Details
This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Ready to Join the Game Makers?
Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

Bus Driver – Northern Sweden
With approximately 15,000 employees across four countries, we are the Nordic region's largest public transport company. Every day, one million people choose to travel more sustainably with us. Together with our passengers and clients, we have a unique opportunity to make a difference, through responsible sustainability and innovative thinking that contributes to more fossil-free journeys. Together, we move society forward every day. Read more at www.nobina.se
Traffic area Norrbotten consists of approximately 150 employees, and we operate around 70 buses every day. Together with our client Länstrafiken Norrbotten, we are responsible for operating and developing bus services in area Boden/Luleå/Piteå/Älvsbyn.
Personal qualities and qualifications
As a bus driver at Nobina, you are sociable, flexible and enjoy meeting people. You handle stressful situations in a calm and confident manner and always drive safely and with environmentally awareness. In this role, you take responsibility for both passengers and the vehicle, in line with the Nobina Driver standard and our passenger promise. This means that you:

Welcome passengers and provide the information they need for a safe and positive journey

Drive safely, comfortably and with a green mindset, following all traffic regulations

Take care of the bus and report any damage or risks you notice

Contribute to a good working environment and collaborate with colleagues

Stay up to date and participate in required training

We are looking for someone who:

Has the right to work in Sweden (EU citizenship or a valid Swedish work permit)

Holds a Category D driving licence and a valid CPC/YKB (Code 95) issued in an EU/EEA country

Has a valid driver card (tachograph card)

Has at least 1 year of professional bus-driving experience within the last 3 years

Has communicative English skills

Is willing to work shifts, including mornings, evenings and weekends

Is motivated to learn Swedish.

What do we offer?

Salary according to Swedish collective agreement

Temporary accommodation on arrival (small fee)

Health and social insurance

Free job-specific Swedish training

Full operational training

Support with relocation and formalities

EU/EEA driving experience recognised for salary placement

Fixed-term or permanent employment

As a new employee at Nobina, you will receive a thorough introduction and the opportunity for continued skills development.
As part of the recruitment process, digital tests are carried out. The tests are sent to you by email. Before you are offered a job with us, you will be asked to complete a health examination.
Why Nobina?
At Nobina, we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where every employee feels valued. Our leaders take responsibility, make courageous decisions, and consistently embrace an outside-in perspective to meet the needs of our passengers. By being business-driven and focusing on the bigger picture, we strive to develop our operations and create sustainable solutions for today and the future. In a coaching way, we are engaging. Our culture is built on respect, care, and responsibility, and we constantly seek new perspectives to drive innovation.
Welcome with your application!

Are you looking to lead large-scale digital transformations? In this role, you will step into the intersection of marketing, data, and technology to help international brands grow.
About the role
In this senior role, you will bridge the gap between marketing and complex IT by designing scalable MarTech ecosystems. You will act as a strategic advisor to C-level executives while guiding technical teams from initial concept to successful implementation.
You are offered
Our client offers a highly collaborative environment where you can drive large-scale digital transformations, work with leading-edge technologies, and enjoy professional growth in a senior leadership position.
Work tasks

You will lead the architecture and delivery of MarTech solutions (with a specific focus on Adobe or Salesforce) for clients across the Nordic region.
You will own the end-to-end architectural process—from evaluating current-state maturity to designing target architectures and executing delivery roadmaps. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, translating complexity into clear business outcomes.
Architecture & Strategy: Own the complete MarTech architecture (current-state assessment, target state design, and roadmap execution).  
Solution Design: Lead solution architecture for campaign orchestration, customer journeys/flows, segmentation, data models, and integrations.  
Delivery Leadership: Drive delivery quality through requirements gathering, planning, prioritization, risk management, and cross-team coordination.  
Technical Guidance: Provide advice on APIs, integrations, and data flows within the broader MarTech ecosystem.  
Mentoring: Guide and support specialists and engineers within the delivery team.

We are looking for
Has a strong background in marketing technology and experience leading architecture and delivery projects. You possess excellent communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.
Qualifications:
Extensive experience within marketing technology (MarTech) or marketing operations (from an agency, consultancy, or in-house environment).
Hands-on experience in technical architecture within either the Adobe or Salesforce ecosystem.
Proven experience working with Customer Data Platforms (CDP) to create a 360-degree customer view and build advanced segmentations.
Strong understanding of commercial sales and marketing processes.
Demonstrated track record in stakeholder management and delivery leadership.
Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Desirable qualifications:

Experience with advertising technology (AdTech) for activating and measuring digital campaigns.
Experience implementing a composable CDP architecture.
Knowledge of email deliverability, compliance, QA tools, and multi-channel campaign best practices.

Joining our team means working alongside a group of highly skilled and passionate professionals from across the globe.

Develop simulation models in different tools used for power system studies.
Develop tools to allow virtual representation of real-time control and protection system. 
Produce technical documentation and reports. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand different requirements and design solutions. 
Engage with customers throughout the process, from specification to final acceptance.
Stay up to date with industry trends and best practices related to simulation models and tools. 

Your Background 
Master's or bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, or a related field. 
5+ years experience with control/signal theory, dynamic modelling, or power system tools (for example PSCAD, PSSE, PowerFactory, PSLF, EMTP-RV, Hypersim, Dymola, PSS® NETOMAC, etc.) is required. 
Knowledge and/or interest in programming (C++, C#, Fortran, Python, MATLAB, Modelica). 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
Ability to work and solve problems independently and take own initiatives. 
Fluency in English is required, as you will be part of a company that operates on a global scale.
